headline: Auditors reported no findings so far on the city's June 30, 2026 audit, but grant testing is still open.
summary: CLA reviewed open audit items, including state grant testing, water and sewer cash accounts, and capital assets. The federal single audit will not be finished by year end because the federal government has not yet issued its compliance supplement. Gabe Epstein will issue a draft of the financial statements by December 4.
plain_text:
A special meeting of the Banking & Audit Committee of the Board of Finance was held 
on November 20, 2026 at 8:30 a.m. in the City Hall Meeting Room 1-3, 111 North Main 
Street, Bristol. 
 
Members Present: Dave Maikowski, Jon Mace and Jane Murdock  
Also Present: City: Diane Waldron, Robin Manuele, Jessica Pilgrim, and Jodi Bond  
CLA: David Flint and Gabe Epstein 
 
1. Call to order. 
 
Chairman Maikowski called the meeting to order at 8:30 a.m. 
 
2. To discuss the June 30, 2026 Audit with CLA and to take any action as necessary. 
 
Dave Flint and Gabe Epstein from CLA reviewed the open items for the Audit.  
• State Single Audit – Additional State Grants to test this year. BOE HVAC Grant 
and Local Capital Transportation testing still needs to be done  
• Small items with Water/Sewer, need to go out there to review cash accounts and 
interview Tim Smith and Dawn LaBella 
• Federal Single Audit will not be done by end of year.  While the deadline is 
March 31 the Federal Government has not yet issued the compliance supplement 
that provides the audit guidelines and testing procedures  
• Capital Assets are in review, finishing the Capital Outlay recognition.  Diane 
stated the change in the thresholds helped this year  
 
Gabe will prepare the financial statements, and issue a draft by December 4, with the 
MD&A pre-filled for Diane to update.  After that it needs to be reviewed and reviewed 
by CLA compliance teams. There is a new standard this year which reorganizes the 
MD&A. CLA will send a template and screen shot examples. The outstanding list of 
items was sent to the City and is being reviewed. Overall, the audit is in better shape at 
this time than last year.  
 
Dave stated at this point, there isn’t anything that raises concerns. Gabe stated at this 
point there are no findings, but grants still need to be reviewed.  
 
3. Adjournment. 
 
The meeting adjourned at 8:55 a.m. 
 
Jodi A. McGrane 
Recording Secretary
